blocks.text: Before I send the closure notice to the group, I want next week settled so no one has to guess who is in, and I would like the first three days treated as a soft reopening with light hours while people come back from the break. Most of the attorneys are out through Wednesday, the phones roll to the front desk, and I will note in the message that Sharon Woods is the point of contact for anything on the docket calendar, so those questions land in one place instead of five.
Send me the coverage grid for the week by tomorrow afternoon, and I will fold it into the notice before it goes out.
